fields.name: input_image
fields.label: Source image
fields.tooltip: One clear object, tight framing. Background is removed automatically (birefnet) unless bg_removal=off.

fields.name: seed
fields.label: Seed
fields.tooltip: Same seed + image = same mesh take.

fields.name: resolution
fields.label: Resolution
fields.tooltip: 512 fast (props/thumbnails), 1024 standard, 1536 hero (rides the upsample stage).

fields.name: steps
fields.label: Steps
fields.tooltip: STRUCTURE stage steps (the lift). Shape runs 20, texture 12 — calibrated upstream.

fields.name: cfg
fields.label: CFG
fields.tooltip: Structure-stage guidance. Upstream template calibrates 7.5 for max fidelity; 3.0 runs looser/faster.

fields.name: bg_removal
fields.label: Background removal
fields.tooltip: auto/on: birefnet cuts the background (recommended). off: feed a pre-cleaned or alpha-cut image straight to conditioning.

fields.name: filename_prefix
fields.label: Filename prefix
fields.tooltip: Output .glb name prefix (the run stamps resolution + seed).
